reviewed.by: PENDING — gates not yet run. DEITY-OF-CHRIST TIER: this needs DUAL CONSENSUS (apologia-orthodoxy AND apologia-neutrality) plus apologia-argument before any stamp. SOURCE IS library/hands.html, THE CERTIFIED ESSAY. STANDING CONSTRAINTS: (1) HANDS IS A CUMULATIVE CASE, NOT FIVE PROOFS. The essay says so explicitly and its FAQ repeats it: HANDS 'works as a cumulative case rather than a single proof text'. S is ONE FINGER OF FIVE and the reel must say so, or it claims for the Seat what only the five together carry. That is scope, not concession. (2) THE AGENCY / SHALIACH OBJECTION IS THE ESSAY'S OWN STRONGEST, and reels are positive-case-only so it is NOT voiced here. But the reel must not walk into it: never say merely that Jesus SITS AT God's right hand, which is exactly what the agency reading grants (the exalted Messiah of Psalm 110, the man at God's side). The load-bearing fact is the SINGLE SHARED THRONE of Revelation 22:1,3 — 'an agent represents the sender; he does not share the sender's throne'. Keep the Revelation beat; it is what the Psalm 110 beat alone cannot do. (3) STATE THE SECOND TEMPLE FRAME POSITIVELY, as the essay does: ruling from the one throne was an IDENTITY MARKER, not a job description a creature could be hired for. 'The function presupposes the identity.' Never present this as a rebuttal of an objection the reel has not voiced. (4) 'The most quoted Old Testament verse in the New Testament' is the essay's claim about Psalm 110:1 — keep it verbatim and let apologia-citations verify it. (5) The acronym is Bowman and Komoszewski's; the underlying divine-identity logic is Bauckham's and Hurtado's. Credit correctly and do not present HANDS as scholarship in its own right. (6) Do not claim the throne texts prove Chalcedon. The essay concedes 'you cannot read Chalcedon's metaphysics straight off the page of Mark'. (7) PACING is deliberately generous per the owner; gen_reel.py OVERLAPS crossfades so each real reading window is dur minus 0.6 except the last. (8) RETIRED — this reel is cards-only, so there is no voiceover to diff against. See the cards-only rule below. || ROUND 2 — orthodoxy (0 heresy, 1 DRIFT, 3 NOTE) and neutrality (1 BREAK, 2 WEAK) both applied, and the VOICEOVER FIELD IS REMOVED at the owner's direction: this reel is cards-only, so EVERY hedge must live on a card and there is no second surface to hide one on. (a) [DRIFT] 'Not a prophet' entailed that Jesus is not a prophet, which is false — Scripture gives him the title in his human office (Deut 18:15; Luke 24:19; Acts 3:22) — and on the opening card it read to a Muslim viewer as a swipe rather than an argument. Now 'No mere prophet.' (b) [BREAK] Scenes 10-11 stated BAUCKHAM'S divine-identity thesis as unattributed flat fact, which is the registry-retired class 'divine-identity-consensus' (allow: []), and left the reel LOOSER THAN BOTH TIERS ABOVE IT: library/hands.html attributes it and says 'it is contested', and the already-certified ev-m-hands.html carries the full hedge naming Hurtado and James F. McGrath. Now attributed, with 'the case reshaped the field, it is still argued over in it' on the card. (c) [WEAK, AND IT CORRECTS THIS FILE'S OWN CONSTRAINT 2] The load-bearing answer to the agency reading is NOT the throne. ev-m-hands.html: 'The agency category explains the sending; it BREAKS AT THE ALTAR.' The throne is the second item in a supporting list. Worse, scene 11 named 'He alone is worshipped' as an identity marker and the reel then never claimed it for Jesus — four markers listed, one cashed, the strongest leg left on the floor, while Revelation 3:21 ('I will grant him to sit with me on my throne') is a same-book counter-text a Witness produces in one line. A worship scene is now inserted (Rev 5:13-14 against the angel's refusal at 19:10 and 22:9) and the 'SO' scene gathers both legs. DO NOT CUT IT FOR RUNTIME. (d) [WEAK] 'The most quoted Old Testament verse' is COUNTING-CONVENTION DEPENDENT: Psalm 110:1 leads on quotations PLUS allusions, but Leviticus 19:18 leads on bare direct quotations (8-10 against five). The essay says it in a subordinate clause; round 1 gave it a 9.4s gold scene and added 'in the WHOLE New Testament'. Now 'no Old Testament verse is quoted and echoed more often', which is true on every convention. PROPAGATION DEBT, STILL OPEN: the unhedged wording is live at library/hands.html:158 and ev-m-hands.html:366. (e) [NOTE] Chalcedon gap closed the way that STRENGTHENS the reel rather than lecturing: 'the Lamb who was slain' (Rev 5:6,12), because the scandal of Revelation 22 is that the SLAIN one shares the seat. Do NOT fix this with 'God died' phrasing — that is a theopaschite pull-quote. (f) 'Everywhere' intensified the essay's 'pervasively' into a falsifiable claim about the corpus (James, Jude, 2-3 John); now 'Everywhere you look'. ev-m-hands.html:365 has the same drift. (g) 'But put the hand together' framed the cumulative bound as an obstacle; now 'Now'. CERTIFIED CLEAN AND NOT TO BE UNDONE: the Rev 22 reading holds — a single articular throne with two genitive possessors and singular pronouns in v3; the cumulative bound in 'HOLD IT AS THEY INTENDED' is what makes 'NOW PUT THE HAND TOGETHER' safe — trim it and the four-of-five assertion has no on-screen support and becomes a BREAK. REFER TO SCENES BY KICKER, NOT BY NUMBER: inserting the worship scene shifted every index after 11 by one, and the round-2 note protected the wrong cards; and both throne errors are closed structurally, with no exaltation narrative anywhere. || ROUND 3 — orthodoxy (0 heresy, 0 drift, 2 NOTE, fix strings pre-certified) and neutrality (0 BREAK, 3 WEAK). BOTH LENSES INDEPENDENTLY FOUND THE SAME KICKER. 'HE ALONE' over four predicates of GOD had lost its antecedent — it sits on the previous card across a crossfade, REELS LOOP AND ARE ENTERED MID-SCROLL, and gold is this reel's Jesus-claim colour, so a viewer landing cold reads 'He' as the Son and 'He alone created all things' then EXCLUDES THE FATHER FROM CREATION. Now 'ISRAEL'S GOD ALONE'. Also: the worship card set both halves side by side and never stated the inference, so screenshotted alone its loudest words were 'Worship God!' — a Witness's own two proof-texts (Rev 19:10; 22:9) quoted approvingly, readable as 'worship is reserved to God alone, therefore the Lamb's honour is not worship', which is the reading Witnesses defend by rendering proskyneo of the Lamb as 'obeisance'. The essay's own gated sentence now lands it: 'The Lamb receives what the angel forbids.' And the contestedness hedge was a chiasmus with two antecedents for 'it' in eleven words — fine when a voice carries the stress, skimmed at 36pt on a silent card, and it is the ONLY line in the whole reel that says this is contested. Now it names what is argued over. ⚠ CARDS-ONLY BY OWNER DIRECTION. There is no voiceover script and the CapCut kit will print '(no voiceover text in this spec)'. IF NARRATION IS EVER ADDED IT IS NEW CONTENT and re-opens argument + orthodoxy (deity tier: dual consensus). DO NOT IMPROVISE IT IN THE EDITOR. ⚠ IF RUNTIME MUST COME DOWN, take it from the 'BECAUSE OF WHAT SITTING MEANS' and 'BUT REVELATION GOES FURTHER' scenes — NEVER from the worship scene or the cumulative bound, which are the two rounds 2 and 3 added specifically to stop this reel overclaiming and are the two that read as most skippable. ⚠ DO NOT ADD HURTADO AND McGRATH AS A NAMES LIST: they are not co-belligerents — Hurtado AGREES with the high-Christology conclusion and dissents on method, McGrath disputes the category and the conclusion — so grouping them would be a false-grouping defect worse than the omission. ⚠ DO NOT PROMOTE THE CONTESTEDNESS LINE TO GOLD: dim is this reel's scholarly-apparatus register, which is where it belongs, and gold would over-weight a concession. || OUTSIDE THIS FILE, FOUND BY NEUTRALITY AND STILL OPEN: the unhedged Psalm 110 claim is live on FIVE surfaces, not two — library/hands.html:158, ev-m-hands.html:366, ev-s3.html:279 AND :346 (a free, indexed fragment, twice), and tools/reel/specs/is-jesus-god-hands.json:12. Port the corrected string 'quoted and echoed more often', which is true on every counting convention.
